title: Sweet-Savory
summary: Caramelized onions, maple glaze, teriyaki — sweetness needs salt and acid to taste complex.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — sweet-savory is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: sweet, salt, umami. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Add soy or fish sauce for depth
If cloying, add acid; if flat, add salt before more sugar.
